column4: Kernel is a thin wrapper that calls NtAlertThreadByThreadIdEx with lock=0. Sogen iterates threads by id and sets t.alerted=true. The sticky-alert semantic (alerted flag survives if target not yet waiting) is correct — ntdll SRW lock fast path requires this. Matches observable contract.

Kernel resolves thread via PspCidTable, checks same-process ownership, calls KeAlertThreadByThreadIdEx. Sogen delegates to NtAlertThreadByThreadId (lock param silently ignored). Cross-process delivery returns STATUS_ACCESS_DENIED — sogen skips cross-process check but both parties must be in the same process in single-process emulation, so this is safe.

Kernel calls ExpAllocateUuids under ExpUuidLock, writes time/range/sequence/seed. Sogen writes matching fields via monotonic counter. time.QuadPart != 0 is asserted by the io-ops-sample test. Field layout matches ULARGE_INTEGER+ULONG+ULONG+seed. Correct.

Kernel acquires packet spinlock, sets associated=1, stores io_completion+target+key+apc+status, calls KeRegisterObjectNotification. Sogen mirrors this: validates all handles, checks already-associated/queued, sets associated=true, stores all fields, calls materialize_signaled_wait_packets. Correct.

Kernel unwinds callback stack via InitialStack pointer chain and restores trap frame. Sogen pops callback_stack frame, restores registers via frame.restore_registers(), dispatches completion with callback_result. The observable contract (resume at pre-callback RIP with result value) is correctly implemented.

Kernel acquires packet spinlock, clears association, optionally dequeues from io_completion if remove_signaled_packet. Sogen: if remove_signaled_packet && queued_completion, removes from io_completion queue; then calls release_wait_packet_association. Matches kernel behavior.
Kernel is a 1-line wrapper calling NtSecureConnectPort with server_sid=NULL. Sogen delegates to handle_NtSecureConnectPort identically. Correct.
Kernel is a thin wrapper calling NtContinueEx(ContextRecord, TestAlert). Sogen delegates to handle_NtContinueEx. Correct.

Kernel stub is hand-crafted asm; contract derived from NtContinue wrapper + KiContinueEx docs. Sogen reads KCONTINUE_FLAG_TEST_ALERT from continue_argument, restores CONTEXT via cpu_context::restore, yields if alert requested. Matches observable resume-at-ContextRecord.Rip contract.

Kernel parses boundary descriptor, creates directory object, inserts into ObpNameSpaceTable. Sogen parses boundary descriptor entries (Name/IL/SID), validates counts, creates private_namespace object keyed on boundary_name. Object semantics match (create→collision on duplicate, open→not-found if missing).

Kernel creates IopWaitCompletionPacket object via ObCreateObjectEx, initializes associated/queued fields to 0. Sogen creates wait_completion_packet with same zero initialization, supports named dedup. Matches kernel object lifecycle.

Kernel validates io_completion handle, validates worker process (must be current process), allocates factory object. Sogen validates io_completion_handle and worker_process_handle, stores factory fields, calls ensure_worker_factory_threads. Core validation logic matches.

Kernel calls ObpRemoveNamespaceFromTable to remove the namespace. Sogen marks ns.deleted=true and erases from proc.private_namespaces. The deleted flag prevents re-open without a new create — matches the kernel's removal-from-table semantics.

The kernel implementation is a 31-byte syscall stub (KiServiceInternal redirect). On x86-64, I-cache coherence is guaranteed by hardware; the call is a no-op. Sogen returns STATUS_SUCCESS — correct for x86-64 emulation.
Kernel calls KeFlushProcessWriteBuffers (equivalent to MFENCE) with no user-visible state change. Sogen is single-threaded; no write-ordering issue to address. Returns STATUS_SUCCESS — correct.

Kernel reads Group and GroupIndex from KPRCB of current processor. Sogen writes zero-initialized PROCESSOR_NUMBER (Group=0, Number=0, Reserved=0). For a single-CPU emulator this is the only valid response. Correct.

Kernel spawns a kernel thread (MUIRegistrySystemRoutine) to populate MUIRegistryLock-protected global. No equivalent OS thread infrastructure in sogen. STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_NOT_FOUND is a safe fallback (callers treat it as "no MUI info available"). Correct DEFER.

Kernel opens/creates an NLS section by name, maps it. For type 11 (codepage), sogen reads the NLS file from virtual filesystem, allocates guest memory, and writes pointer+size. The observable effect (mapped codepage data) matches.

Kernel maps the global locale section into current process. Sogen reads locale.nls from virtual filesystem and maps it into guest read-only memory, writing base address and locale id 0x407. The observable effect (locale.nls mapped at returned base) matches.

Kernel returns 0 (STATUS_SUCCESS) when PsUILanguageComitted!=0. Sogen always returns TRUE (non-zero, which equals STATUS_SUCCESS=0 as a boolean). Wait — the kernel returns 0 when language IS committed. Sogen returns TRUE (1). For NTSTATUS comparison TRUE==1 which is not STATUS_SUCCESS. But looking at the sogen code: `return TRUE;` and TRUE==1, while STATUS_SUCCESS==0. The misc-ops-sample test checks `NT_SUCCESS(fn())` which is `fn() >= 0` — both 0 and 1 satisfy this. The stub is consistent with "language is committed". Acceptable approximation.

Kernel parses boundary descriptor and looks up namespace in ObpNameSpaceTable. Sogen delegates to open_or_create_ns with open=true, returning STATUS_OBJECT_PATH_NOT_FOUND if not found and STATUS_OBJECT_NAME_COLLISION not triggered. Correct open-only semantics.

Kernel routes to PopPowerInformationInternal for per-level dispatch. For ProcessorInformation(11), sogen writes PROCESSOR_POWER_INFORMATION with 3000 MHz (CurrentMhz == MhzLimit). Test confirms CurrentMhz > 0. All other levels: kernel writes power-state data; sogen zeroes the buffer (safe for "AC powered, no idle" approximation). Correct.
Kernel delegates to NtQueryInstallUILanguage(). Sogen writes 0x407 (German) as UI language, matching the fixed locale. Test confirms lang != 0. Correct.

Kernel calls SLQueryLicenseValueInternal to query from software licensing policy. Sogen re-implements by parsing the ProductPolicy binary blob from registry (same data source), finding the entry by name, writing type and data. The format parsing matches the documented ProductPolicy binary structure. Correct.

Kernel calls ExpLeaveWorkerFactoryAwayMode then ExpWorkerFactoryCheckCreate to signal a worker is available. Sogen increments pending_release_count, enqueues an io_completion release message when not already pending (ensuring the factory loop gets a wakeup). The contract (release causes a completion packet to be posted) is correctly approximated.

Kernel performs full LPC port connect with SID validation via AlpcpDereferenceBlobEx path. Sogen allocates shared view memory, stores port_container keyed by name, zeroes connection_info. The observable contract (caller gets a port handle, can send messages via NtAlpcSendWaitReceivePort) is satisfied. Correct.

Kernel dispatches on WORKERFACTORYINFOCLASS. Sogen handles: Timeout/RetryTimeout/IdleTimeout (LARGE_INTEGER, size check), BindingCount (signed delta, clamped), ThreadMinimum/Maximum/Paused/Priority/Flags/SoftMaximum (ULONG, size check). Info-class coverage and size validation match the kernel decomp (a2==11→size 4 path at LABEL_2/3). Correct.

Kernel reads/writes power request flags and may notify power manager. In the emulator there is no power manager; sogen writes ES_CONTINUOUS (0x80000000) to previous_flags and returns STATUS_SUCCESS. This satisfies the "keep the system awake" use case which is the common caller intent. Correct approximation.

Kernel calls ExpShutdownWorkerFactory, waits for rundown protection, then returns pending worker count. Sogen sets shutdown=true, clears worker_threads, writes 0 to pending_worker_count. The observable effect (factory stops spawning threads, pending count returned) matches.

Kernel routes to ETW dispatch table keyed by function code. Sogen handles: AddNotificationEvent (0x1B) — validates event handle and stores it; RegisterGuids (0x0F) and SetProviderTraits (0x1E) — passthrough returning STATUS_SUCCESS; other codes → STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED. Covers the critical ETW startup path correctly.

Kernel calls Win32k GetKeyboardLayout(threadId) to return the per-thread HKL. Sogen has no input stack; returning 0 (STATUS_SUCCESS as HKL=NULL) is the correct behavior for a headless emulator. Callers tolerate NULL HKL.

Kernel calls KeWaitForAlertByThreadId. Sogen checks t.alerted (consume sticky alert → STATUS_ALERTED), else sets waiting_for_alert=true and yields; respects timeout via await_time. The sticky-alert-first-check-before-block ordering matches the kernel contract required by SRW lock fast path.

Kernel calls IoRemoveIoCompletion on the factory's io_completion port, blocking if needed. Sogen dequeues io_completion entries into mini_packets; if empty, sets await_io_completion wait with factory timeout. The completion-packet delivery mechanism matches.

Kernel decrements away-mode count, may spawn threads via ExpWorkerFactoryCheckCreate. Sogen calls ensure_worker_factory_threads (which checks limits and spawns if below minimum/binding_count). The "signal ready, spawn if needed" contract is correctly approximated.
